title: TermAl host memory: grows by about 26 GB during runs that create large file trees, and sits at about 4 GB right after a restart
outcome: It is established what the TermAl host allocates while a tracked launcher run with large fixture repositories is active. The host's memory stays bounded during such a run, with no growth proportional to the run's repository size or output. A test shows the bound.
acceptance: The host's post-restart baseline (about 4 GB commit at 00:43Z on 2026-11-06, build from ed2b5e4d) is measured and broken down by major consumer, including the session count (w-b17b985f5dbc). It is either reduced, or each large part is justified with its numbers.

Live criterion, verified after a restart onto the fixed build: a Windows C4 live run with the Phoenix fixtures in an ordinary checkout path runs on Central with the host sampled, and the host stays within the stated bound.
